{{Draft}}
Base tables are the shared lists behind the dropdowns of the forms: object types, materials, qualifiers, countries, languages, types of relations and many more. They are shared by all catalogues and translated into the interface languages; this page shows the English entries. Because a change affects every catalogue, new entries are best agreed with the platform administrator.

Each list below names the fields that use it. Some fields offer only part of a list; the field reference of the form shows exactly which entries.
